# Between the Lines Editorial

> A freelance editorial service providing professional manuscript editing, writing coaching, and publishing guidance for fiction authors.

Between the Lines Editorial, run by editor Hannah, offers comprehensive editorial services including developmental editing, manuscript critique, and author coaching. The site features a resource shop with writing notebooks and webinars, a portfolio of published works, and an active blog with writing advice for novelists.

## Key Topics

- Manuscript Editing
- Writing Coaching
- Editorial Services
- Fiction Writing

## Writing Guides

- [How to Limit Echo Words in Your Novel](https://btleditorial.com/2024/04/30/how-to-limit-echo-words-in-your-novel): Guide to finding and reducing echo words and repetition in manuscripts
- [Crafting Morally Gray Characters](https://btleditorial.com/2023/11/08/morally-gray-characters): Writing guide for creating complex and unique morally gray characters
- [What to Look for in a Book Cover Designer + Font Tips](https://btleditorial.com/2023/10/11/book-cover-designer-tips): Tips for selecting book cover designers and design portfolio evaluation
